name: get_favorite_spots
description: Get group members' saved favorite spots (restaurants/bars/cafes/activities they've said they actually like), to weight venue recommendations toward places people already enjoy instead of only relying on find_nearby_places. Each favorite is tagged with which member saved it. Optionally filter by category and/or a cuisine/theme keyword, using the same vocabulary as find_nearby_places.

category.description: Optional broad category to filter by: restaurant, bar, cafe, activity, or other. Leave blank to return all categories.

keyword.description: Optional cuisine/theme keyword to filter by, matched against each favorite's name and notes - e.g. 'sushi', 'vegan'. Leave blank for no keyword filter. Only include a matching favorite in a proposal if it actually fits the requested activity/cuisine - never force an unrelated favorite in just because someone saved it.
